summary: The coup becomes public in Stohess. Flegel, Hitch, and Marlo choose a side, and the military decides it will not obey a false crown.

segments.ja: 信頼の舞台は、ストヘス区です。区は、かつて女型の戦いが街を割った場所です。割った記憶の上で、今日は人間同士の戦いが紙で起きます。起こす側は、エルヴィンと、彼を支持する軍です。支持は、まだ命令の形をしていません。していないあいだ、中央の憲兵は調査の人間を犯罪者として追います。追う街で、フレーゲルは父の名を隠すのをやめます。やめる声が、今日の最初の信頼です。
segments.en: The stage of trust is Stohess District. The district is the place where the Female Titan's fight once split the city. On top of the memory of that split, today's fight between humans happens on paper. The side that makes it happen is Erwin and the military that supports him. The support does not yet have the shape of an order. While it does not, the interior military police chase the survey's people as criminals. In the city that chases, Flegel stops hiding his father's name. The voice that stops is today's first trust.

segments.ja: フレーゲルは、商会の跡目より先に、殺された順序を公にします。公にする場所は、人が集まる通りです。通りの人は、調査兵団が商人を殺したという中央の話を先に持っています。持っている話を、彼は銃の方向で覆します。覆す声は震え、しかし止まりません。止まらない声を、ハンジの班が憲兵の妨害から守ります。守ることが、信頼を紙にするための腕です。腕が無ければ、声は通りで終わります。
segments.en: Before the succession of the company, Flegel makes public the order in which his father was killed. The place he makes it public is a street where people gather. The people of the street already hold the interior's story that the Survey Corps killed the merchant. He overturns the story they hold with the direction of the guns. The voice that overturns shakes, and it does not stop. Hange's squad protects the voice that does not stop from the military police's interference. Protecting it is the arm that puts trust onto paper. Without the arm, the voice ends in the street.

segments.ja: 証言は、その日の紙になります。なる紙を、中央は刷らせまいとします。まいとする倉庫で、調査の兵士と憲兵が押し合います。押し合う力は、刃より肩です。肩の結果、紙は街へ出ます。出た紙が、王の名とレイスの名を同じ頁に置きます。置かれた頁を、人はすぐに信じ切りません。信じ切らないことが、信頼という題の難しさです。難しさは、一回の活字では終わりません。終わらない活字を、人は夜まで読みます。
segments.en: The testimony becomes that day's paper. The interior tries not to let the paper it becomes be printed. In the warehouse of that trying, survey soldiers and military police shove. The force of the shoving is shoulders, more than blades. As a result of the shoulders, the paper goes out into the city. The paper that went out puts the king's name and the name Reiss on the same page. People do not immediately believe the page that was put there all the way. Not believing all the way is the difficulty of a title called trust. The difficulty does not end with one printing. People read the printing that does not end until night.

segments.en: Hitch still holds Annie being inside the crystal as a hole where a colleague was. Beside the hole she holds, Marlo tries to stand on the side of the rules. She makes fun of him as he tries to stand, and she does not leave. The two who do not leave see the interior's wrongdoing in the military police lodgings at Stohess. The wrongdoing they see is a document that makes the survey into criminals. Marlo says the document is a betrayal of the rules. The trust he states is not the king. It is the law that is written.

segments.ja: マルロは、憲兵であることが汚い仕事だとは思っていませんでした。いませんでした、という過去が、今日割れます。割れたあと、彼は不正を止める側に制服のまま移ります。移ることは、出世を捨てることです。捨てる顔を、ヒッチはついに本気だと認めます。認めた二人が、紙を配る列に加わります。加わることが、アニの不在を埋めることにはなりません。なりませんが、街の信頼を一人分増やします。
segments.en: Marlo had not thought that being military police was dirty work. The past of that not-thinking cracks today. After it cracks, he moves, still in uniform, to the side that stops wrongdoing. Moving means throwing away promotion. Hitch finally admits that the face that throws it away is serious. The two who admitted join the column that hands out paper. Joining does not fill Annie's absence. Even so, it increases the city's trust by one person.

segments.en: At the top of the military, Zachary is watching which order to obey. The materials he watches are Erwin's restraint and the paper that went out into the city. The paper that went out makes the king's order no longer absolute. He measures the absolute that was lost on his own table. The judgment he measures is to take the truth outside the walls over a false crown. The judgment he takes pulls the coup toward the legal side. The power that pulls is not personal friendship. It is the public trust that the military doubts the king.

segments.ja: エルヴィンは、この信頼を自分の命で賭けています。賭けは、地下室と、壁の外の無知を終わらせるためです。ための顔を、部下は初めて賭け師として見ます。見る賭けが外れれば、調査兵団は反逆です。反逆の可能性を、彼は隠しません。隠さないことが、今日の信頼の条件です。条件を、ピクシスは南の軍で支えます。支える砲が、中央の隊を街の外に出さない壁になります。
segments.en: Erwin is betting this trust with his own life. The bet is to end the basement and the ignorance outside the walls. The subordinates see the face of that purpose, for the first time, as a gambler. If the bet they see fails, the Survey Corps is treason. He does not hide the possibility of treason. Not hiding it is the condition of today's trust. Pyxis supports the condition with the southern military. The guns that support it become a wall that does not let the interior's squad out into the city.

segments.ja: 街の信頼が紙になるあいだ、リヴァイはエレンの場所を追っています。追う先は、レイスの領地です。領地の下に、二人を置く儀式があると、痛みの報告が示しています。示された先へ、残った班が進みます。進む速度は、クーデターの成功を待てません。待てない理由は、ヒストリアがエレンを食べる儀式が先に終わるかもしれないからです。かもしれない夜を、彼らは短縮します。その確認は、街の角を一つ余分に見ることです。
segments.en: While the city's trust becomes paper, Levi is pursuing Eren's location. The destination he pursues is Reiss land. The report of pain indicates that under the land there is a ritual that places the two. The squad that remains advances toward the indicated destination. The speed of advancing cannot wait for the coup's success. The reason it cannot wait is that the ritual in which Historia eats Eren may end first. They shorten the night in which that may happen. That check means looking at one extra corner of the town.

segments.ja: ケニーは、リヴァイが来ることを織り込み済みです。済みの配置は、洞窟の入口の銃です。銃は、信頼の紙とは別の言語です。別の言語で、彼は王家の儀式を完成させようとします。させようとする動機は、自分もその力に触れたい、という飢えです。飢えを、今日はまだ彼は口にしません。しないまま、部下に弾を配ります。配る音が、ストヘスの紙の音と同時です。
segments.en: Kenny has already included in his plan that Levi will come. The arrangement that is already included is the guns at the cave's entrance. Guns are a different language from the paper of trust. In the different language, he tries to complete the royal ritual. The motive of trying is a hunger to touch that power himself. He does not yet say the hunger today. Without saying it, he hands bullets to his people. The sound of handing them is simultaneous with the sound of Stohess's paper.

segments.ja: 洞窟の中で、ヒストリアは父の使命を一度は正しい顔で聞きます。聞く顔は、無視された子供がやっと必要とされた顔です。された必要が、エレンの死と交換です。交換を、彼女は信頼できる父の言葉として握りかけます。握りかけた手を、エレンの目が見ています。見ている目は、自分を食べてよいとも、食べるなとも、まだ言い切りません。言い切らない沈黙が、二人の信頼の試験です。
segments.en: Inside the cave, Historia listens once to her father's mission with a face that calls it correct. The face that listens is the face of a neglected child who was finally needed. The need that was given is an exchange with Eren's death. She almost grips the exchange as the words of a father she can trust. Eren's eyes are watching the hand that almost grips. The eyes that watch do not yet say clearly either that he may be eaten, or not to eat. The silence that does not say it clearly is the test of trust between the two.

segments.ja: ストヘスの人は、紙を読んだあと、王家の旗を見ます。見る旗が、急に薄くなります。薄くなった旗の下で、兵士たちはどちらに銃口を向けるか決めます。決める基準が、信頼です。信頼の対象は、より多くを隠さない側です。隠さない側に、調査兵団が立ちます。立つことは、勝利の宣言ではありません。宣言の前の、銃を下ろす選択です。選択が、街の何箇所かで起きます。
segments.en: After reading the paper, the people of Stohess look at the royal flag. The flag they look at suddenly becomes thin. Under the flag that became thin, soldiers decide which way to point the muzzle. The standard of deciding is trust. The object of trust is the side that hides less. The Survey Corps stands on the side that does not hide. Standing is not a declaration of victory. It is the choice, before a declaration, to lower the gun. The choice happens in several places in the city.

segments.en: After handing out the paper, Hitch passes in front of Annie's crystal. When she passes, she calls the colleague neither enemy nor ally. Without calling, she learns that today's trust is on the side of living humans. Learning is not forgiving Annie. Even so, she chooses the paper that speaks over the king that hides. Marlo says the choice she made is a victory of the rules. Beside what he says, Hitch only makes a tired face.

segments.en: The trust that won in the city has not yet reached the Reiss cave. In the place it has not reached, Rod is advancing the preparation of the ritual.
